info.title: API.SH: Just Join IT
info.description: The Just Join IT API from API.SH: public Just Join IT data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free

get.description:
An employer's profile on Just Join IT: name, type, industry, logo, description, social links, main and other locations, founding year, headcount, work mode, dress code, hours, employment types, benefits, the profile's text sections and its current job offers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justjoin-company

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The profile slug (company_profile_slug of a job). slug or url is required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A justjoin.it/brands/story/<slug> link, instead of slug.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job offer on Just Join IT: title, company with size and website, category, experience level, work mode, working time, address with coordinates and other locations, salaries per contract type, required and nice-to-have skills with levels, languages, dates, apply method and link, and the full description. Give `slug` or `url`, or `category`/`q` (plus any search filter) to open the first matching current offer.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justjoin-job

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Offer slug (the part after /job-offer/).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Offer URL on justjoin.it.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City slug (warszawa, krakow, wroclaw, gdansk, poznan, katowice, lodz), remote, or all-locations (default).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug: python, javascript, java, net, php, go, data, ai, devops, mobile, testing, admin, security, ux, pm, support, game, erp, architecture, analytics, html, ruby, scala, c, other.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword (skill, title or company).

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Experience levels, comma separated: intern, junior, mid, senior, expert, manager, c_level.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Work modes, comma separated: remote, hybrid, office, mobile.

parameters.name: working_time
parameters.description: Working time, comma separated: full_time, part_time, internship, freelance, b2b_contract.

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: Contract types, comma separated: b2b, permanent, mandate, specific_task, internship, any.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Offer language, comma separated: pl, en, de, fr, es, uk, ru, it.

parameters.name: posted
parameters.description: Only offers published in the last N days.

parameters.name: with_salary
parameters.description: 1 = only offers that show a salary.

parameters.name: salary_min
parameters.description: Minimum monthly salary in PLN.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Distance around the city in km.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
IT job offers on Just Join IT (justjoin.it, Poland) by city and technology category, with the site's filters: keyword, experience level, work mode, working time, contract type, offer language, posting date, salary and radius, and its sort orders. Each result has the title, company, city and street with coordinates, every location of multi-city offers, salaries per contract type (in the original currency, plus the site's conversions), required and nice-to-have skills, dates and apply method. 50 per page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/justjoin-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
